    <h1>We measure extreme heat and cold where people live, and study how it shapes health as we age.</h1>
    <p class="lede">The Confluence Projects bring clinical informatics, environmental data science, and biostatistics together across Mass General Brigham, Harvard Medical School, and the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. We build high-resolution exposure data, link it to health records, and ask how heat, cold, and air pollution affect dementia and the body's capacity to recover from illness.</p>

<section class="home-section column-page" aria-labelledby="what-we-study">
  <h2 id="what-we-study">What we study</h2>

  <div class="thread">
    <h3>Exposure where people live</h3>
    <div>
      <p>Assigning each person the reading from the nearest weather station misclassifies who was exposed. GridEX estimates daily apparent temperature and extreme heat and cold events on a 500&nbsp;m grid, so exposure can be linked to health data at any geographic scale. Other NIH-funded studies now build on it.</p>
      <p><a href="gridex.html">How GridEX works</a></p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="thread">
    <h3>Recovery and resilience in aging</h3>
    <div>
      <p>Older adults differ in how fully and how quickly they recover after an acute illness. Using longitudinal health records, we measure recovery capacity across organ systems and test whether environmental exposure and inflammation wear it down over time.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="thread">
    <h3>Dementia and the exposome</h3>
    <div>
      <p>With support from the National Institute on Aging, we identify dementia and its precursors in clinical records with AI and examine how long-term environmental exposures relate to its onset and course.</p>
      <p><a href="data.html">Related publications</a></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="gridex-band column-page" aria-labelledby="gridex-data">
  <div>
    <h2 id="gridex-data">GridEX is open data</h2>
    <p>A national catalog of extreme heat and cold events for the contiguous United States, with daily temperature, dew point, wind, and apparent temperature surfaces. Raster layers come as GeoTIFF and event boundaries as GeoPackage, under the MIT license.</p>
    <p>Described in <a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.est.5c03658"><em>Environmental Science &amp; Technology</em> (2025)</a>.</p>
    <div class="home-actions" style="margin-top:1.6rem">
      <a class="btn btn-ink" href="https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/DJGKDJ">Download from Dataverse</a>
      <a class="btn btn-line" href="https://ehce.connect.hms.harvard.edu/us_ehe_ece">Open the interactive catalog</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <dl class="facts">
    <dt>500 m</dt><dd>grid resolution, nationwide</dd>
    <dt>2008–2022</dt><dd>daily coverage</dd>
    <dt>~2,250</dt><dd>NOAA weather stations</dd>
    <dt>800M+</dt><dd>hourly and sub-hourly station records</dd>
  </dl>
</section>

(function () {
  var v = document.getElementById('hero-video');
  var label = document.getElementById('hero-date');
  var btn = document.getElementById('hero-toggle');
  if (!v || !label || !btn) return;
  var frames = [
    'Extreme heat, 15 July 2022', 'Extreme heat, 16 July 2022', 'Extreme heat, 17 July 2022',
    'Extreme heat, 18 July 2022', 'Extreme heat, 19 July 2022',
    'Extreme cold, 21 December 2022', 'Extreme cold, 22 December 2022', 'Extreme cold, 23 December 2022',
    'Extreme cold, 24 December 2022', 'Extreme cold, 25 December 2022'
  ];
  var step = 1.4;
  function sync() {
    var i = Math.min(frames.length - 1, Math.floor(v.currentTime / step));
    if (label.textContent !== frames[i]) label.textContent = frames[i];
  }
  v.addEventListener('timeupdate', sync);
  function setPaused(p) {
    if (p) { v.pause(); btn.textContent = 'Play'; }
    else { var r = v.play(); if (r && r.catch) r.catch(function(){}); btn.textContent = 'Pause'; }
  }
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () { setPaused(!v.paused); });
  var rm = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  if (rm && rm.matches) { v.removeAttribute('autoplay'); setPaused(true); }
})();
</script>
